Seedling / Nursery.irrigation: Keep nursery bed moist; avoid deep flooding for first 7 days.
Seedling / Nursery.fertilizer: 1 kg Urea per 100 sq.m nursery bed.

Vegetative Growth.fertilizer: Apply first top-dressing of Urea (35 kg/acre) at 21 DAT.
Vegetative Growth.action: Hand weeding or early post-emergence herbicide.

Tillering / Branching.irrigation: Alternate Wetting and Drying (AWD) cycle of 3-4 days.
Tillering / Branching.fertilizer: Apply second split of Urea (35 kg/acre) + Zinc Sulfate if deficient.
Tillering / Branching.action: Monitor tillering density and water level.

Flowering & Panicle Initiation.irrigation: Maintain 4-5 cm continuous ponded water; avoid any water stress.
Flowering & Panicle Initiation.fertilizer: Foliar spray of 1% 13-0-45 (Potassium Nitrate) for grain weight.

Grain Filling / Fruiting.irrigation: Shallow water 2-3 cm; irrigate when topsoil begins to dry.

Maturity & Pre-Harvest.irrigation: Drain all standing water 10-14 days before harvest.
Maturity & Pre-Harvest.action: Harvest when 80-85% grains turn golden yellow.

Seedling / Nursery.irrigation: Pre-sowing irrigation (Rauni); first irrigation at Crown Root Initiation (CRI) 21 DAS.
Seedling / Nursery.fertilizer: Basal: Full DAP (55 kg/acre) + 20 kg MOP + 25 kg Urea.

Vegetative Growth.fertilizer: Top dress 40 kg Urea before second irrigation.

Tillering / Branching.action: Scout northern sub-montane fields for yellow rust stripes.

Flowering & Panicle Initiation.fertilizer: Foliar spray of 0.5% Zinc Sulfate + 2% Urea if leaves pale.
Flowering & Panicle Initiation.action: Ensure light irrigation on calm non-windy days to avoid lodging.

Grain Filling / Fruiting.fertilizer: Foliar spray of 1% 0-0-50 (SOP) to combat terminal heat.
Grain Filling / Fruiting.action: Monitor soil moisture to prevent premature grain shriveling.

Seedling / Nursery.irrigation: First irrigation 4-5 days after sowing if rain delayed.
Seedling / Nursery.fertilizer: Basal: 30 kg DAP + 20 kg MOP + 10 kg Magnesium Sulfate.
Seedling / Nursery.action: Gap filling and thinning at 15 DAS.

Tillering / Branching.fertilizer: Split 2: 30 kg Urea + 15 kg MOP at 60 DAS.
Tillering / Branching.action: Nipping/De-topping after 80-90 days to encourage sympodial branches.

Flowering & Panicle Initiation.fertilizer: Foliar spray of 2% DAP or Planofix (NAA) @ 4 ml/15L water to prevent square dropping.
Flowering & Panicle Initiation.action: Pheromone traps for pink bollworm monitoring.

Grain Filling / Fruiting.irrigation: Boll development stage - maintain uniform moisture.
Grain Filling / Fruiting.fertilizer: Foliar spray of 1% 13-0-45 + 0.1% Boron for boll bursting.
Grain Filling / Fruiting.action: Pick mature open bolls in dry morning hours.

Maturity & Pre-Harvest.irrigation: Stop irrigation when 30% bolls have opened.
Maturity & Pre-Harvest.action: Periodic manual picking; dry clean cotton in shade.

Seedling / Nursery.irrigation: Nursery beds watered daily with fine rose-can.

Vegetative Growth.irrigation: Drip irrigation 2-3 hours every alternate day.
Vegetative Growth.fertilizer: Basal: 50 kg SSP + 25 kg MOP + 25 kg 19-19-19.
Vegetative Growth.action: Staking with bamboo poles or trellis twine.

Tillering / Branching.action: Pruning of lateral suckers below first flower cluster.

Flowering & Panicle Initiation.irrigation: Maintain constant root zone moisture; avoid moisture fluctuations.
Flowering & Panicle Initiation.fertilizer: Fertigation with Calcium Nitrate (3 kg/acre) + Boron (500g/acre) to prevent Blossom End Rot.
Flowering & Panicle Initiation.action: Release Trichogramma parasitoids; spray neem oil 1500 ppm.

Grain Filling / Fruiting.fertilizer: Fertigation with 0-0-50 (SOP) @ 4 kg/acre for fruit color and brix.
Grain Filling / Fruiting.action: Harvest mature green or breaker stage for distant transport.
